d.flipScoringAtScale: Scoring engine = scripts/fr13_recurrent_decode_oracle.py rescore (RUNNABLE-NOW, deployment-correct): loads model ONCE in-process (offline vllm.LLM, NO speculation, FLASH_ATTN, eager, max_num_seqs=1) and teacher-forces the served stream ONE single-token decode/position via a per-request AdapterLogitsProcessor — every oracle distribution is the RECURRENT _forward_core_decode_non_spec path (causal_conv1d_update + fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_packed_decode, conv/ssm state carried in KV cache), NOT chunked-prefill, NOT streamed logprobs (the HTTP teacher-force re-prefills prompt+served[:i] => num_prefills>0 => wrong chunked WY frame, documented L1-72). Metric (identical both arms): clear_margin := (served_id != recurrent argmax) AND (served outside oracle top-20 OR deviation_nat = oracle_argmax_logprob - served_logprob_in_oracle > 1.0). Count clear-margin flips, NOT raw flips. Within-process rep1==rep2 per-position determinism recorded (class #8). Schema of --src = {prompts:[str], records:[{served_token_ids:[int]}]} (one pair/turn). Rate = total_clear_margin_flips / n_positions_scored; report Wilson 95% CI. Half-widths at p~5%: n=462 (current) +-2.0%; n~3000 (big run) +-0.8% => cat9 ~[4.2,6.4]% vs native ~[0.3,1.2]% non-overlapping with margin, slack exceeds the +-4-flip wobble. CI on the REAL count after dropping round-trip-fail turns; artifact records n_positions_scored / n_turns_dropped / n_positions_dropped.
d.diffuseDiscriminator: (a) Rate-CI: Wilson 95% CIs both arms; PASS-for-diffuse iff cat9 CI entirely above native CI AND rep1==rep2 holds. (b) Token-class distribution: classify every clear-margin flip + context (from the pair-dump served TEXT) into {code-fence/backtick, JSON/tool-call arg, prose, identifier/code, whitespace/newline, punct/format}; diffuse = flips cluster at small-margin STRUCTURAL boundaries (code-fence/prose<->code/tool-call), fixable = one non-structural format-deterministic class >50%. (c) Leaf-fork vs spine R/C/W split: reuse the apple-to-apple classifier with the CORRECTED reducer (FR13_APPLE_TO_APPLE_FORK sec2: fr13_fork_margin_classify.py::_deciding_margin must join the verify margin AT the oracle FLIP position's own committed row + read the self_logits row for tree_self_target bonus flips; dump via FR13_FORK_MARGIN_DUMP, default-OFF byte-identical); W (instrument) -> ~0, then split C (co-residency near-tie, verify <1 nat right row) vs R (genuine verify-vs-decode, verify >=1 nat right row). At small sample R=8/C=8/W=7; at scale the R:C ratio + whether any single tree depth or leaf slot concentrates forks is the signal. (d) Per-layer first-nonzero on a SAMPLE of ~8-12 R flips (NOT whole stream): same-boot input-aligned ladder (FR10_LAYER_HIDDEN_CAPTURE + node5/node7 reducer, both arms enter L0 byte-exact input_maxabs=0.0), residual-L2/layer; diffuse = no single dominant alignable layer (monotone ~1.05-1.3x/layer, largest jumps deep full-attn L35/47/51/59/62-63, born in L0-GDN), fixable = a reproducible single-layer clean->broken >2x spike.
d.decisionRule: DIFFUSE (relax; ship as lossless-enough IF the SWE-quality gate passes) requires ALL: (1) cat9 CI lo > native CI hi AND CI half-width <0.015 AND rep1==rep2 both arms; (2) no single non-structural token-class >50% of flips AND the structural classes (code-fence+prose<->code+tool-call boundary) together hold the majority; (3) corrected W~0 AND R+C spread with no single tree depth/leaf-slot >~40% of forks AND R:C within ~1:2..2:1; (4) on sampled flips first-nonzero is L0-GDN with no reproducible later-layer >2x spike. FIXABLE (do NOT relax; re-open a lever) on ANY: (1) one non-structural format-deterministic token-class >50% of flips => commit/wiring bug in that path; (2) one tree depth/leaf-slot >~40% of forks or a C spike at a depth => co-residency seam (verify-row isolation/no-copy lever); (3) a reproducible single-layer spike in (d) => that kernel is the seam; (4) cat9 CI collapses onto native (CIs overlap) => the 5% was autotune wobble, no defect (relax for the opposite reason). Verdict non-vacuity: denominator = validated round-trip token count (not text length), oracle counter >0, spec counters did NOT advance during rescore, flags live in worker, W driven ~0 before reading R/C — a diffuse verdict with W>0 or a fictional denominator is INVALID.
d.sweQualityGate: The binding deployable verdict: does cat9 SOLVE the SWE-Verified task (patch applies + tests pass) vs native-E5 DESPITE the ~5% clear-margin flips? Capture is what run_swe_bench_q36_a.py already does: per task/arm, codex-bench-eval-swe runs patch.diff against the instance tests => resolved/failed in per-task report.json / campaign summary. PASS/FAIL: PASS (deployable-lossless-enough) = cat9 resolved where native-E5 also resolves on the solvable instance (flips did not change outcome — consistent with the gold gate's codex SOLVING task1 on the tree despite ~6% non-argmax commits); FAIL (quality-relevant) = cat9 failed where native-E5 resolved on the SAME instance => flips broke the solve, relaxation unsafe, re-open; CONTROL = both fail (astropy-13033) is a draw, not a tree regression, does not gate. Run the solvable PRIMARY with N>=2 same-instance repeats/arm (gold gate ran tree_a/tree_b, native_a/native_b) so resolved is not a single coin-flip; the gate is "cat9 resolves at the same rate as native on the solvable instance." Section3 says WHAT the residual is; section4 says whether it MATTERS. Diffuse + SWE-quality PASS => ship cat9; Fixable OR SWE-quality FAIL => do not relax.
